title: Pre-Transplant Nutrition Counseling in Patients With Multiple Myeloma
official: PREPARE: PRE-transPlant Nutrition Counseling to Attenuate Malnutrition and Improve REcovery in Patients With Multiple Myeloma
summary:
The primary endpoint of this pilot randomized controlled trial (RCT) will evaluate the feasibility and acceptability of an 8-week pre-hematopoietic stem cell transplant (HSCT) nutrition counseling intervention aimed at improving dietary intake and quality before HSCT to attenuate post-HSCT malnutrition among up to 20 patients with multiple myeloma (MM).

Hypothesis: An 8-week pre-transplant nutrition counseling intervention will be feasible and acceptable among patients with MM undergoing HSCT.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Subject age \>= 18 years old
* Individuals newly diagnosed with multiple myeloma undergoing hematopoietic stem cell transplantation as part of first line therapy
* Willingness to engage in virtual nutrition counseling intervention one day per week for eight weeks if assigned to the nutrition counseling group
* Willingness to complete 1-3 food records using Cronometer dietary tracking app each week for eight weeks if assigned to the nutrition counseling group
* Willingness to complete four virtual assessment sessions (baseline, post-intervention, pre-HSCT, post-HSCT)
* Able to provide informed consent and willing to sign an approved consent form that conforms to federal and institutional guidelines

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients with multiple myeloma for whom hematopoietic stem cell transplantation is not planned
* Patients who do not speak English will be excluded for this pilot trial due to inadequate funds and staffing to successfully execute this trial in languages other than English
